D.tier: Queued, roster and office levers only

D.t: Vicente Gonzalez leads by 10.4 in the forecast and wins 96% of simulations. The cushion is about 27,232 votes; a one point swing is about 1,313 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +2.7 and D +17.5. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$2.5M cash against $285K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.

D.h: What the ballots so far say
D.t: The early vote has moved this forecast 0.2 points toward Vicente Gonzalez. Bank it: chase the remaining mail ballots and low propensity voters who have not voted.

R.t: Eric Flores trails by 10.4 and wins 4% of simulations. Closing it takes about 13,616 voters switching sides, or 27,232 more net votes from new turnout.

$285K cash against $2.5M. Outspent: lean on earned media, digital, field and the outside groups, and pick the two or three media markets that decide it.
